_comment: /etc/waf-report/apps.json (640 root:root) — the apps waf-report reports on. One entry per app: its hosts, its session cookie (Str::slug(APP_NAME).'-session' unless SESSION_COOKIE overrides it), the exclusions file the report points at, and its channels. Channel secrets are never in here: each channel names the root-only file it reads them from. Channel types: ntfy (topic_key, default NTFY_TOPIC; optional server), mail (the app's own MAIL_* and to_key, default APP_CONTACT), discord (webhook_key, default DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL), file (path; for trying a configuration). http3_default: true on the one app that listens on HTTP/3, whose requests reach ModSecurity without a Host.
